{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.Word
import Data.Bits
import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Marshal.Array
import Foreign.Storable
import System.IO.Unsafe
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, forever, void)
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO)

data Role = Admin | User | Guest deriving (Eq, Show, Read)

data Session = Session
  { sessRole    :: Role
  , sessUser   :: String
  , sessBuf    :: Ptr Word8
  , sessBufLen :: Int
  , sessRetAddr :: Ptr Word8
  } deriving (Show)

maxBufSize :: Int
maxBufSize = 256

retGadgetOffset :: Int
retGadgetOffset = 264

allocSession :: Role -> String -> IO Session
allocSession role user = do
  buf <- mallocArray (maxBufSize + 16)
  retBuf <- mallocArray 8
  return $ Session role user buf maxBufSize retBuf

freeSession :: Session -> IO ()
freeSession sess = do
  free (sessBuf sess)
  free (sessRetAddr sess)

checkAccess :: Role -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
checkAccess Admin _ = True
checkAccess User cmd
  | BS.isPrefixOf "READ" cmd = True
  | BS.isPrefixOf "LIST" cmd = True
  | BS.isPrefixOf "STAT" cmd = True
  | otherwise = False
checkAccess Guest cmd
  | BS.isPrefixOf "STAT" cmd = True
  | otherwise = False

parseRole :: BS.ByteString -> Role
parseRole bs
  | BS.isPrefixOf "ADMIN" bs = Admin
  | BS.isPrefixOf "USER" bs  = User
  | otherwise                 = Guest

copyToSessionBuffer :: Session -> BS.ByteString -> IO Int
copyToSessionBuffer sess payload = do
  let payloadLen = BS.length payload
      bufPtr = sessBuf sess
      -- Vulnerability: bounds check uses signed comparison on
      -- a value derived from header-specified length field,
      -- but actual copy uses BS.length which can exceed buffer
      -- when the declared length underflows via truncation
  let declaredLen = fromIntegral (BS.index payload 0) :: Word8
      actualCopyLen = payloadLen - 1
      adjustedLen = (fromIntegral declaredLen) .&. 0x1FF :: Int
  -- The check compares adjustedLen (from attacker-controlled byte)
  -- but copies actualCopyLen bytes (full payload minus header byte)
  if adjustedLen <= maxBufSize
    then do
      let src = BS.drop 1 payload
      BS.useAsCStringLen src $ \(srcPtr, len) -> do
        copyArray bufPtr (castPtr srcPtr) len
        -- If len > maxBufSize, overwrites past buffer into retAddr
        when (len > maxBufSize) $ do
          let overflow = BS.drop maxBufSize src
          BS.useAsCStringLen overflow $ \(oPtr, oLen) -> do
            pokeArray (sessRetAddr sess) =<< peekArray (min oLen 8) (castPtr oPtr)
      return actualCopyLen
    else return 0

handleCommand :: Session -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
handleCommand sess cmd = do
  if checkAccess (sessRole sess) cmd
    then do
      bytesWritten <- copyToSessionBuffer sess cmd
      return $ C8.pack $ "OK: processed " ++ show bytesWritten ++ " bytes"
    else
      return "ERR: access denied"

handleClient :: Socket -> IO ()
handleClient conn = do
  authData <- recv conn 1024
  let role = parseRole authData
      user = C8.unpack $ BS.takeWhile (/= 0x20) $ BS.drop 6 authData
  sess <- allocSession role user
  sendAll conn $ C8.pack $ "AUTH OK role=" ++ show role ++ "\n"
  loop sess
  where
    loop sess = do
      cmd <- recv conn 4096
      if BS.null cmd
        then freeSession sess
        else do
          resp <- handleCommand sess cmd
          sendAll conn resp
          loop sess

main :: IO ()
main = do
  sock <- socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol
  setSocketOption sock ReuseAddr 1
  bind sock (SockAddrInet 8080 0)
  listen sock 5
  putStrLn "Proxy listening on port 8080"
  forever $ do
    (conn, _) <- accept sock
    void $ forkIO $ handleClient conn
